info.title: Analytic Madhyasth Darshan discussions API
info.description: Per-study discussion boards on https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org. Readers sign in with an email magic link (no GitHub account required) to post comments. Structured corrections still use GitHub Issues. All POST requests require an exact trusted Origin and Content-Type: application/json, including logout. Local preview origins must be explicitly configured. All responses are private/no-store, include comment permissions where applicable, and carry an X-Request-ID header. Magic links are single-use and expire after 15 minutes. JSON error responses use one envelope: success=false, code, message, requestId, and optional details; the error body uses the same request ID. Opening a sign-in link is read-only; an explicit confirmation POST consumes it. Tokens bind the allowed return destination. Repeated sign-in does not change an existing display name. Legacy outstanding links must be replaced. Direct-reply email is account-scoped and opt-in, off by default. Unsubscribe links require explicit confirmation and do not authenticate. Reports require sign-in and are visible only to moderators.
